title: Merge Overlapping Ranges
description:
## Task

Merge every group of ranges that overlap or touch into one range. Two ranges touch when one starts exactly where the other ends.

## Input

- `ranges` — a list of `[start, end]` pairs of integers with `start ≤ end`, in any order. It may be empty.

## Output

A list of merged `[start, end]` pairs, sorted by `start`, none of which overlap or touch.

## Example

```python
merge_ranges([[6, 9], [1, 3], [2, 4], [9, 12]])  # returns [[1, 4], [6, 12]]
merge_ranges([[0, 1]])  # returns [[0, 1]]
```

## Constraints

- 0 ≤ length of `ranges` ≤ 10^4
- -10^9 ≤ `start` ≤ `end` ≤ 10^9
